endpoint.name: Phototoxicity
endpoint.historical_animal_test: In Vivo Acute Phototoxicity / Photo-irritation in Animals

context_of_use: Identifies the phototoxic potential of chemicals activated by exposure to light, evaluating photo-cytotoxicity through relative viability reduction in Balb/c 3T3 cells (+UVA vs -UVA) using PIF (Photo-Irritation Factor) and MPE (Mean Photo Effect) metrics.
